summary: The diff implements the single-page Royal Flame homepage with most requested sections, styling, navigation, and interactive features (lightbox, reservation form validation/success). However, some requirements are incomplete or mismatched, notably the Gallery image set size and missing section IDs for in-page navigation targets. Several unrequested platform/authentication features were also added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Homepage renders as a single scrolling page with all requested sections present and navbar links scroll to the correct section IDs (Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Reservations, Contact).
missing_requirements.reason: The Why Choose Us and Testimonials sections do not include explicit section IDs, which can make anchor navigation/in-page linking incomplete for the full set of sections and section-based structure.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a sticky top navbar with a right-aligned gold-accent “Reservation” button.
missing_requirements.reason: Navbar includes a gold-accent button, but its label is “Reserve Table” rather than the requested “Reservation” wording.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement a Gallery section as a responsive grid of food and interior images with a lightbox preview effect.
missing_requirements.reason: BuildRequest specifies 8 gallery images (gallery-1 through gallery-8), but the GallerySection only uses 6 images (gallery-1 through gallery-6).

missing_requirements.requirement: Add and use generated static image assets for the hero, about, featured menu items, gallery, and logo, stored under frontend/public/assets/generated.
missing_requirements.reason: The UI references generated assets paths, but the diff summary does not include the actual image files under frontend/public/assets/generated (they may be in omitted files, but this cannot be verified from the provided diff summary).

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication provider/hooks and actor creation with React Query integration.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asks for a static, conversion-focused homepage and does not request authentication, identity handling, or canister actor plumbing.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend Motoko canister stub added (empty actor).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not require backend changes for this homepage; it only constrains backend shape if later added.

hallucinated_features.description: Caffeine.ai attribution/UTM link logic in the footer (including appIdentifier computation).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in the BuildRequest requirements or acceptance criteria.
